# What the shell guard does not see: each command here would destroy data and passes untouched.
# docs/SHELL_GUARD.md "What it doesn't see" lists the same cases. A change that starts catching one
# moves it to asks.txt and updates that page.

# A value known only at run time.
CMD="prisma migrate reset --force"; npx $CMD

# A word built from a variable.
npx prisma migrate "$ACTION" --force

# SQL produced by another command.
psql -c "$(printf 'DROP TABLE %s' users)"

# Encoded text.
echo ZHJvcGRiIGFwcA== | base64 -d | sh

# An interpreter running its own code.
python -c "import os; os.system('dropdb app')"

# A file the guard isn't given (no working directory), or a Makefile target.
make db-reset

# An alias or shell function defined earlier in the session.
resetdb

# An unquoted heredoc's command substitution (bash runs it; the guard reads the body as text).
cat <<EOF
$(dropdb app)
EOF

# An ORM call made from application code.
node -e "require('./db').sequelize.drop()"

# A database the command reaches over HTTP.
curl -X DELETE https://api.example.com/v1/databases/prod
